race.comment: The Waller pair hold the aces but we'll side with ROYAL MAXIMUS (2) who is only second up off a strong return at Ballarat, chasing hard behind a handy winner in Goodness. Just left with a bit too much to do there, now fitter and maps for every hope with Lane sticking. SONDERA (11) is another knocking on the door having just found one better in her past couple. Peaks now and looks the clear, and potentially only danger. SAVANINA (10) didn't figure on debut at Mornington but should be an improver out to 1400m. CELESTIQUE (8) was in the same race at Mornington and whacked away, she'll be picking off a couple late.
